proposed.justification: The proposition proves the only strict-extension statement used in the proposal: the new two-dimensional class strictly contains the actual compact-polyhedral Theorem 4 overlap, with strictness supplied by an explicit asymmetric game.
proposed.gap: Assumption 5 with Theorem 4 of \cite{MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Local} covers a directionally differentiable centrosymmetric class. This proposition compares only on the defined compact-polyhedral overlap and does not claim that the proposed class contains the full published Assumption-5 class.
proposed.consumer: Researchers can identify exactly when the published centered solver is in scope and when the asymmetric all-saddle analysis supplies genuinely additional admissible games.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Synchronize the dependency and metadata fields with the narrowed, fully proved strict-overlap claim; the removed published-rule agreement clause no longer contributes a dependency.

open_obligations.what_is_open: A finite necessary-and-sufficient classifier using only covariance-whitened endpoint-face normals, face incidence, and supports of face-complete least-favorable priors remains unproved.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen primitives give the full optimal correspondence through Bayes-score signs plus a continuum of binding Gaussian convolution inequalities. They contain no reduction showing that prior weights and those continuum moment constraints are determined by the requested finite support geometry, and no pair of games proving that such a reduction is impossible.
open_obligations.attempted: The complete saddle characterization was used with an arbitrary face-complete prior. This isolates the unique-score case and the tie-set perturbation case exactly, but compressing the latter's continuum of risk inequalities to the proposed normal-fan data would assume the central claim.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Neither an explicit rational unbalanced-prior interval certificate nor a two-dimensional impossibility theorem is present in, or derivable from, the frozen primitives.
open_obligations.obstruction: The question requires concrete rational support and mass data, outward-rounded enclosures of global Gaussian integrals and derivatives, a rational truncation and tail bound, and exact primal--dual closure. No such numerical candidate or enclosure is supplied, so inventing one would not be a proof.
open_obligations.attempted: The algebraic closure and geometric implication were separated and proved in \(\mathrm{thm:curved-score-no-index-certificate}\). The available triangular game was also checked, but it proves coexistence through a balanced equalizer and does not instantiate the demanded unbalanced curved-score certificate.
